items.description: Mantsonyane is a mountain town in the Thaba-Tseka district, serving as a hub for the central highlands.
Ha Baroana is famous for its exceptionally well-preserved San rock paintings, a window into ancient times.
Ha Moitsupeli is a traditional Basotho village where the local heritage and customs are still very active.
Marakabei is a key transit point in the Maloti Mountains, located near the banks of the Senqu River.
Ha Kome is famous for its unique cave dwellings that were once built into the cliffs for protection.
Likalaneng is a remote village in the highlands, known for its rugged terrain and breathtaking views.
Maphutsaneng is a peaceful settlement located in the picturesque Maphutseng River valley.
Tele is a significant border crossing point between Lesotho and the Eastern Cape of South Africa.
Ha Sekake is a village in the Qacha's Nek district, acting as a regional center for the surrounding mountain communities.
Ha Rafanyane is a small highland settlement where the traditional pastoral way of life is still very prominent.
Mashai is a regional administrative center in the Thaba-Tseka district, overlooking the Senqu River valley.
Linakaneng is a remote and high-altitude village, reachable mostly by mountain trails and pony trekking.
